official_statement_rationale: While headline CPI inflation at 7.44% is significantly elevated, it is primarily driven by transient supply-side shocks in food items, as evidenced by the 11.51% food inflation print. Crucially, core inflation has moderated to 4.90%, indicating that generalized demand-pull pressures remain contained. Monetary policy is a blunt instrument that cannot effectively address specific food supply-side volatility; an aggressive tightening response would risk unnecessarily dampening the robust 7.80% GVA growth momentum. With the repo rate at 6.50%, real interest rates are already in positive territory, providing a sufficient anchor for inflation expectations. I support maintaining the current repo rate and the stance of withdrawal of accommodation to ensure price stability while allowing the post-pandemic recovery to sustain its trajectory.
